name: dsh-retro-crt-theme
description: Retro CRT phosphor theme: pure-black Matrix green / 40K amber-green / TFEL amber screens with bold glowing text and a code-rain boot animation
author: charonpi

title.zh: 复古 CRT 磷光主题

description.zh: 纯黑底、粗胖字、强泛光的 CRT 荧光屏主题：黑客帝国 P1 绿 / 战锤40K 黄绿 / TFEL 琥珀三种屏种，附代码雨开机动画与 BIOS 风控制面板。
description.en: A pure-black CRT phosphor theme with bold glowing text: Matrix P1 green, Warhammer 40K amber-green, or TFEL amber, plus a code-rain boot animation and a BIOS-style control panel.
